title: Casual Talking Camera Testimonial

user_check.note: The opening was suitably vague, the first reply answered only the first of three questions, and the next briefly answered both plain-word questions using bank facts.

withheld.fact: The ad is vertical, for a social reel.
The picture should be nine units tall for every five units wide.
The free-tier picture quality is fine.
The presenter is a made-up woman in her thirties, not a real customer.
She films herself at home and talks to the camera.
She says: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.”
Matching captions show what she says.
The voice and mood are friendly and casual.
The assistant can choose the accent.
The assistant can choose the clothing, room and music.

judge.note: The assistant asked clear, relevant questions and faithfully reported the credit refusal, but stopped clarifying too early and attempted a speechless gym commercial instead of discovering the testimonial, presenter, exact words and captions.
